[b][size=xx-large][color=#ffffff][u]Hack Forum News - Edition 51[/u][/color][/size][/b]

[b]Welcome back to the Hack Forum News. Where we keep you up to date on the weekly events and news happening on site and around the world. If you have never heard of the Hack Forum News, don't worry, we have you covered. We are a team of members from the Hack Forums community who are journalists and writers, and we are here to keep you in the loop of the changes around the site and the events happening around the world.[/b]

[hr]

[img]https://hackforums.net/images/hfnews/headlines-red.png[/img]
[size=medium][b]Writer -[/b][/size] [mention=2745296]

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6326400][color=#ffffff]Good Will Monday 2026[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

This week on Hack Forums we celebrated Good Will Monday, an official Hack Forums holiday created to kick off the summer with some good vibes. The goal of the event is simple, show appreciation to fellow members by leaving them a positive Popularity rating, formerly known as reputation. Over the years Hack Forums has been built by its community and the members who continue contributing, helping others and keeping discussions active every day. Events like this are a great reminder that even small gestures can help make the forum a more positive and welcoming place for everyone. To make this year’s Good Will Monday event even more special, one random member who left a +Popularity rating during the event was selected to receive 5000 Bytes. The winner of this year’s Good Will Monday event is [mention=807307] If you haven't already, please join us in congratulating them and thank you to everyone who participated and helped spread some positivity throughout the forum.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6326430][color=#ffffff]HF Summer Kickoff 2026 Winners[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

The Hack Forums Summer Event has officially come to an end and we would like to thank everyone who participated throughout the event. It was great seeing the increased activity around the forum and so many members getting involved over the run of the giveaway. Congratulations to all of the winners and thank you once again to everybody who took part. We truly appreciate everyone who continues contributing to Hack Forums and helping keep the community active. We hope you all enjoy the rest of your summer and stay tuned for more future events and giveaways coming soon.

[u][b][size=large][url=https://hackforums.net/showthread.php?tid=6326667][color=#ffffff]Banned and Closed Postbit Change[/color][/url][/size][/b][/u] By [mention=1]

This week Hack Forums received a small but important update regarding closed and banned accounts. From now on when an account is closed or banned, the credibility and popularity sections will display the message “DO NOT DEAL WITH THIS MEMBER”. This change was implemented following a community suggestion aimed at helping newer members more easily identify accounts that should no longer be trusted or contacted. In some cases contact information can still remain visible on older threads or marketplace posts which may lead to confusion for less experienced users browsing the forum. By replacing the normal popularity and crediblity display with a clear warning message, the goal is to improve awareness and provide an extra layer of protection for the community. We always appreciate members who continue submitting suggestions and feedback that help improve both the community and the overall forum experience. Thank you.

[color=#C10300][b][size=15]The Hidden Price of Free Things[/size][/b][/color]
People are naturally drawn to anything labeled free. Free apps, free games, free trials, free services. But many of the things we use every day are not truly free—we often pay with our time, attention, privacy, or habits. Companies compete for attention because attention is valuable. The more carefully you choose where to spend it, the more control you keep over your life.
[hr]

[color=#FF851B][size=15]Advice of the week[/size][/color]

Treat your attention like money. Spend it on things that give you value in return.

[hr]

[color=#008E02][size=15]Quote of the week[/size][/color]  

“The price of anything is the amount of life you exchange for it.”
— Henry David Thoreau
